# E154 -- Aix-Marseille Universite Brand Guidelines (2024)

## Metadata
- **Brand:** Aix Marseille Universite (amU)
- **Industry:** Higher Education
- **Country:** France
- **Year:** 2024 (updated 16/07/24)
- **Source PDF:** efb970540900425a1f66d2da27781d59.pdf
- **Pages:** 76+
- **Produced by:** Studio Plastac
- **Language:** French
- **Contact:** dircom-contact@univ-amu.fr

## Brand Strategy
- Positioning as a major French public university
- Guidelines framed as a practical tool ("not a constraint") to ensure visual coherence
- Templates and files available on amUbox internal platform
- No explicit mission/values/personality section visible in early pages

## Logo
- Primary logotype: "amU" wordmark with oversized capital U, followed by "Aix Marseille Universite" stacked text
- Distinctive typographic construction: lowercase "am" + uppercase "U" creates a strong visual mark
- **Partner lockup** (p.6): Used below 35mm or when co-branded; minimum clearspace = width of the "U" before and after the logo; shown with CNRS, Friche la Belle de Mai examples
- **Cartouche version** (p.7): Enclosed rectangular version for use on colored backgrounds or over images; available in black, white, yellow, blue, and inverted variants to ensure visibility
- **Composite logotypes** (p.10+): amU lockup combined with partner institution logos (INSPE, IUT, Polytech, Observatoire Pytheas, etc.) using a vertical divider bar
- **Institute logotypes** (pp.12-13): Color-coded abbreviated faculty/school names appended to the amU mark, organized by sector:
  - Sante (health): teal/green (Pharmacie, Sciences medicales)
  - Sciences et technologies: teal/cyan (Sciences, Sport, Polytech, Pytheas)
  - Pluridisciplinaire: purple (INSPE, IUT)
  - Arts, lettres, langues, sciences humaines: coral/salmon (ALLSH, CFMI, MMSH)
  - Droit et sciences politiques: dark green (FDSP, IMPGT, EJCAM)
  - Economie et gestion: orange (FEG, IRT)
- Each sector gets a distinct color for the abbreviated institute name
- Extensive system covering 14+ sub-sections of logo usage across 22 pages

## Outliers & Unique Elements
- Exceptionally structured TOC with 9 major sections and granular subsections
- Separate logotype systems for institutes, research schools, foundations, and services
- Dedicated "Formes" (shapes) system with construction rules and pictograms
- Environmental/spatial branding section included

## Quality Score
3 / 5
Thorough and well-organized with an exceptionally detailed logo system accommodating a complex institutional hierarchy. Strong structure across 76+ pages with dedicated sections for shapes, pictograms, and environmental branding. However, limited brand strategy/positioning content visible, and the guidelines appear primarily visual/technical rather than strategic. The color-coded faculty system is a standout institutional branding approach.
